name: Slipstream banishes and makes the target immune to damage (#451)
contract: Slipstream 707555 applies three APPLY_AURA effects: SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN (12), SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_IMMUNITY (39, all schools) and SPELL_AURA_DUMMY (4). The first two are core engine aura handlers (AuraEffect::HandleAuraModStun, AuraEffect::HandleAuraModSchoolImmunity) with no per-spell script required, so casting Slipstream already banishes (stuns) the target and makes it immune to all damage. A melee attack against the banished target should deal zero damage. The dummy effect (recast to relocate the target) has no destination-target data in Spell.dbc to express a location change and is not covered by this scenario. Slipstream is DmgClass 1 (magic, Arcane), so Unit::MagicSpellHitResult gives it a 96% base hit chance against the same-level (80) dummy; the fixture's spell_hit_rating removes that miss roll, as melee_hit_rating does for the melee swing.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Slipstream's banish aura lands on the target
The banished, immune target takes no damage from the attack
